d: At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: You’re only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra is what drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and instead create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for Fortune 500 companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. And we make this lofty standard a reality by fusing strategy, data, design and technology together to arrive at solutions that set the bar higher for everyone.
We use these values to fuel superior results
We forge relationships that make our impact 1,000x stronger. This means working across departments and engaging both our clients and our communities to deliver the greatest good.
We’re not ones to sit on our hands and wait. Instead, we anticipate opportunities, collectively roll up our sleeves and find ways to execute the exceptional.
From new technologies to workplace philosophies, we welcome the unexpected and constantly anticipate what’s next.
We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.
We motivate each other to push past the easy answers and collectively arrive at bigger, more inspiring ideas.
q: As a Salesforce Business Consultant, you will operate at the intersection of business consulting, process architecture and Salesforce solution design, leading clients from abstract business vision to structured, implementable requirements and ensuring alignment between business objectives and Salesforce capabilities. You will play a critical role in shaping enterprise-wide process transformations, defining business architectures and enabling scalable Salesforce programs across multiple clouds. This role needs a client-facing consulting professional with exceptional communication skills, deep industry understanding and strong process modelling skills (BPMN) to drive measurable business outcomes.
A consulting-led business professional with strong domain understanding and executive presence.
An exceptional communicator who makes clients feel heard, comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders and translating strategy into executable solutions.
Able to operate across strategy, functional design, and delivery governance.
Structured, outcome-oriented, and skilled at simplifying complex business problems.
Proactive and entrepreneurial, with a focus on long-term client value and growth.
8+ years of experience as a Business Architect, Functional Lead, or Senior Consultant in Salesforce or digital transformation programs.
Strong client-facing experience, leading workshops, stakeholder alignment, and requirements definition.
Expertise in business process modelling (BPMN) and requirements engineering.
Experience with enterprise CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle CRM.
Proven delivery of functional artifacts (process maps, capability models, solution blueprints).
Nice to have: solid understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities and design trade-offs (configuration vs. customization).
Nice to have: experience across core Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Experience; exposure to Commerce/Revenue/Data Cloud is a plus).
Candidates with one or more of Salesforce consultant certificates (Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce, Revenue etc) are preferred.
r: Lead structured discovery and stakeholder workshops to define business objectives, pain points, and transformation opportunities.
Translate business intent into capability models, BPMN process architectures, epics, and user stories.
Define future-state operating models and end-to-end process designs aligned to Salesforce best practices.
Own requirements lifecycle management from ideation to backlog refinement, prioritization, and acceptance criteria.
Ensure end-to-end traceability from business outcomes to solution design and delivery.
Partner with Technical Architects and delivery teams to translate requirements into robust, multi-cloud solutions.
Enforce platform best practices, design guardrails, and industry standards.
Oversee functional validation, UAT strategy, and business acceptance to ensure alignment with intended outcomes.
Develop capability roadmaps, transformation blueprints, and prioritization frameworks aligned to client strategy.
Advise on CRM maturity, process optimization, and customer experience transformation.
Define business cases and value realization frameworks with clear linkage to KPIs and outcomes.
Support target operating model (TOM) definition and governance structures for scalable adoption.
Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, driving value-led conversations and continuous improvement.
Support pre-sales, solution shaping, and proposal development with strong functional context.
Contribute to solution narratives and executive storytelling aligned to business outcomes.
Identify expansion opportunities, cross-cloud use cases, and process-led transformation initiatives.
Contribute to practice assets, accelerators, and delivery frameworks.
Drive adoption of structured methodologies (BPMN, capability modelling, backlog governance).
Support internal enablement on industry trends, Salesforce innovations, and functional patterns.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.

To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.

Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.

To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.

As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
q: Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
Familiarity with public or private cloud management

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
